senses.gloss: द्वैगुण्य द्वैगुण्य i. e. द्वि-गुण + य, n. Double the amount, Man. 8, 151.
द्वैजात द्वैजात, i. e. द्वि-जाति + अ, adj. Belonging to one of the three higher classes, Man. 8, 374.

द्वैत द्वैत, i. e. द्वि + ता + अ, n. Duality, Prab. 21, 8.
 --Comp.
द्वैतवन द्वैतवन, i. e. द्वितवन + अ + अ, adj. Referring to Dhvasan Dvaitavana, i. e. son of Dvitavana, MBh. 3, 928.

द्वैध द्वैध, i. e. द्विधा + अ, n.
 1. Duality, Man. 2, 14 (two texts)
 2. Difference, Man. 9, 32.
 3. Contradiction, Man. 8, 73.
 4. A contest, a personal conflict, MBh. 5, 5828.
 5. Duplicity, Pañc. iii. d. 62.
 6. Division of an army, Man. 7, 167.

द्वैधीभाव द्वैधीभाव, i. e. द्वैध-भू + अ, m.
 1. Duality, MBh. 14, 809.
 2. Doubt, MBh. 7, 1211.
 3. Uncertainty, Śāk. 15, 11.
 4. Duplicity, Pañc. iii. d. 59.
 5. Division of an army, Man. 7, 160.

द्वैध्य द्वैध्य, i. e. द्विधा + य, n. Duplicity.
 --Comp.
द्वैपक्ष द्वैपक्ष, i. e. द्वि-पक्ष + अ, n. Two parties, MBh. 8, 4432.

द्वैपायन द्वैपायन, i. e.
 1. द्वीप + आयन, m. A name of Vyāsa, MBh. 1, 2416.
 2. द्वैपायन + अ, adj. Referring to Vyāsa, MBh. 9, 1743.

द्वैमातुर द्वैमातुर, i. e. द्वि-मातृ + अ, adj.
 1. Having different mothers, Rājat. 4, 355.
 2. Having another mother, 5, 22.

द्वैरथ द्वैरथ, i. e. द्वि-रथ + अ,
 I. adj. combined with युद्ध, and subst. n. without युद्ध, A single fight in chariots, Rām. 6, 86, 27; MBh. 4, 1061.
 II. m. An adversary, Bhāg. P. 7, 8, 34.
द्वैराज्य द्वैराज्य, i. e. द्वि-राजन् + य. n. A dominion divided between two princes, Mālav. 69, 17.

द्वैविध्य द्वैविध्य, i. e. द्वि-विध + य (see विधा), n.
 1. Duality, twofold character, Bhāṣāp. 141.
 2. Duplicity, MBh. 15, 236.
